blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — A federal grand jury in Los Angeles on Tuesday indicted the estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, on charges that he kept child abuse material – including photos where Markle himself was pictured with prepubescent children, according to prosecutors. If convicted, Thomas Wayne Markle, 82, could be sentenced to up to 40 years in prison, according to a statement shared by top Los Angeles federal prosecutor Bill Essayli. Markle was arrested in early November after federal officials say they found dozens of illicit images, including film negatives, slides and books depicting suspected child abuse, in a […]...
